## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The `preview` containment check needs fixing before merge, because a `relative` value containing `..` passes the check and can read files outside the home directory.

## Changes
The pull request adds `preview` and `settings_file` helpers to `app/paths.py`, adds tests for them in `tests/test_paths.py`, and adds a one-line file, `tests/review-note.txt`.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../../etc/passwd")` passes the check and returns the start of `/etc/passwd`, because `Path.is_relative_to` compares path text without collapsing `..`. A symlink inside home that points elsewhere also passes the check. The only outside-path test, at `tests/test_paths.py:20`, uses an absolute path. — Any caller that passes user-chosen relative paths exposes the first 200 characters of any file the process can read. — Fix: Call `.resolve()` on both `candidate` and `Path(home)` before calling `is_relative_to`, and add a `..` case to `test_preview`.
